doc: Orbit's starting SEMANTICS vocabulary for adapter declarations (ADR 0035): the fields an adapter states about how the system it reaches behaves, so an obligation can ask whether what it needs holds without the engine knowing any product. Every field accepts "unknown", which switches off the features that depend on it and is never read as a default. An organisation adds fields in <storeBase>/organization/adapters/semantics/*.json and a project in <store>/adapters/semantics/*.json; a field nobody declares is still kept and shown on an adapter, and derives nothing. test/adapter-contract.test.mjs holds every row to a known kind.
